recommendations.title: Hydration & Fluids
recommendations.desc: Drink 2.5–3 liters of warm water, clear soups, or ORS daily.

recommendations.title: Adequate Bed Rest
recommendations.desc: Allow physical recovery with uninterrupted rest.

recommendations.title: OTC Pain & Fever Relief
recommendations.desc: Consider Paracetamol 650mg after doctor consultation if temperature exceeds 100.5°F.

recommendations.title: Warm Steam Inhalation
recommendations.desc: Perform steam inhalation twice daily for 5-10 minutes.

recommendations.title: Salt Water Gargle
recommendations.desc: Gargle warm saline water 3 times daily to relieve mucosal soreness.

recommendations.title: Dark Room Relaxation
recommendations.desc: Rest in a quiet, dark room away from mobile screens.

recommendations.title: Cold Compress
recommendations.desc: Apply an ice pack or cool cloth to temples for 15 minutes.

recommendations.title: Electrolyte Fluid Sips
recommendations.desc: Take small, frequent sips of coconut water or ORS to prevent dehydration.

recommendations.title: Bland Diet Recovery
recommendations.desc: Eat light, non-spicy foods like rice and curd.

recommendations.title: Emergency Care Trigger
recommendations.desc: Seek urgent clinic care if chest tightness or breathlessness persists.

recommendations.title: Immediate Physical Rest
recommendations.desc: Stop physical activity immediately and lie in a calm position.

recommendations.title: Emergency Hospital Visit
recommendations.desc: Go to the nearest hospital emergency room for evaluation.
